professionalSummary.text: Develops embedded C firmware for motor control or user interfaces on 32-bit microcontrollers.
professionalSummary.witness: wrote the BLDC motor-control loop for a dishwasher circulation pump in C on an STM32 microcontroller and tuned it on the bench with the hardware team.

experienceHighlights.text: Implements IEC 60730 Class B self-test routines.
experienceHighlights.witness: Implemented the Class B RAM, ROM-CRC and clock self-tests required under IEC 60730 for the dishwasher main board and documented them for the external test laboratory.

projectsAndWorkSamples.text: Maintains unit-test and hardware-in-the-loop test suites.
projectsAndWorkSamples.witness: Maintained the Unity unit-test suite and the hardware-in-the-loop rig that replays door, water-level and temperature signals into the main board overnight, and released the tested builds to the factory programming station.

skills.text: Holds a functional safety engineer qualification covering software, for example the TÜV Rheinland Functional Safety Engineer.
skills.witness: Functional Safety Engineer (Software), TÜV Rheinland programme, certificate ID FS/SW 18820/24, awarded March 2024.
